page.notes: Page number "391" is partly obscured; read as 391 with doubt. Several Hebrew vowel points and forms are uncertain and not marked individually; the Hebrew of the dictionary entries (e.g. the forms after "sa", "si", "sæ", the root in "altitudo", "tua", "malapunica" and "inusit") should be checked against the scan. The entry "attollunt se" continues across the column break and is joined into one paragraph. The Hebrew line "רָמוּ attollunt se" at the foot of the left column was read as רָמוּ. The printed "No." beside "spicula" appears struck through in the scan.
